description: RALEIGH, N.C. – Representative Chris Humphrey (R – Lenoir, Greene, Jones) has formally sent a letter to the North Carolina Cemetery Commission expressing concern about the deteriorating condition of roads in and around Pinelawn Cemetery in Kinston.
